The '''ancient Durese syllabary''' was the writing system of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] and corresponded to the [[Durese/Legends|Durese]] [[Language/Legends|language]]. It was derived from the [[Rakatan writing system]].<ref name="Written Word" />
